entries.title: Ezekiel 48:1
segments: And these [are] the names of the tribes. From the north end, at the hand of the way of Hethlon [to] the entrance of Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, at the hand of Hamath. And there shall be to it an east side and a west: one [part] for Dan.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:2
segments: And by the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, one [part] for Asher.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:3
segments: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, one [part] for Naphtali.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:4
segments: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, one [part] for Manasseh.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:5
segments: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, one [part] for Ephraim.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:6
segments: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, one [part] for Reuben.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:7
segments: And by the border of Reuben from the east side to the west side, one [part] for Judah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:8
segments: And by the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the heave offering which you shall offer: twenty-five thousand [cubits] wide and long, as one of the [parts], from the east side to the west side. And the sanctuary shall be in its middle.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:9
segments: The heave offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand cubits long, and ten thousand cubits wide.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:10
segments: And for these shall be the holy heave offering for the priests; northward, twenty-five thousand; and westward ten thousand wide; and eastward ten thousand wide, and southward twenty-five thousand long. And the sanctuary of the LORD [shall be] in the middle of it,

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:11
segments: for the priests who are sanctified, of the sons of Zadok, who have kept My charge, who did not go astray when the sons of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:12
segments: And the heave offering shall be theirs, from the heave offering of the land, the holiest of the holy places, by the border of the Levites.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:13
segments: And the Levites [shall have] alongside the border of the priests twenty-five thousand [cubits] long, and ten thousand wide. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:14
segments: And they shall not sell any of it, nor trade it, nor cause the first-fruits of the land to pass away. For [it is] holy to the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:15
segments: And the five thousand that are left in the width in front of the twenty-five thousand [shall be] common for the city, for dwelling and for open land. And the city shall be in her midst.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:16
segments: And these shall be its measures: the north side, four thousand and five hundred; and the south side, four thousand and five hundred; and on the east side, four thousand and five hundred; and the west side, four thousand and five hundred.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:17
segments: And the open land of the city shall be northward two hundred and fifty, and southward two hundred and fifty; and eastward, two hundred and fifty; and westward, two hundred and fifty.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:18
segments: And the rest in length alongside the heave offering of the holy [parts shall be] ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward. And it shall be alongside the heave offering of the holy [part]. And its produce shall be for bread to those who serve the city.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:19
segments: And he who serves the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:20
segments: All the heave offering [shall be] twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand, four-square. You shall offer the holy heave offering to the possession of the city.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:21
segments: And the rest [shall be] for the ruler, on this [side], and on that [side] of the holy heave offering, and of the possession of the city, in the front of the twenty-five thousand of the heave offering to the east border, and westward in the front of the twenty-five thousand to the west border, alongside the [lots] for the ruler. And it shall be the holy heave offering. And the sanctuary of the house [shall be] in her midst.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:22
segments: And to the ruler shall be from the possessions of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, amidst [that] for the ruler; between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the ruler.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:23
segments: And the rest of the tribes, from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one [part].

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:24
segments: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one [part].

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:25
segments: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one [part].

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:26
segments: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one [part].

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:27
segments: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one [part].

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:28
segments: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, and to the torrent toward the Great Sea.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:29
segments: This [is] the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these [are] their parts, says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:30
segments: And these [are] the exits of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:31
segments: And the gates of the city [shall be] by the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward, one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:32
segments: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred, and three gates: and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:33
segments: And the south side, four thousand and five hundred measures, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:34
segments: The west side, four thousand and five hundred, their gates three: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

entries.title: Ezekiel 48:35
segments: All around [it shall be] eighteen thousand [cubits]. And the name of the city from [that] day [is] JEHOVAH IS THERE.
